stress.how_enabled: Add stress to loss.loss_property with a loss function such as mse_stress and a weight in loss_property_weights; stress is then read from the data.

settings.name: finetune_from_model
settings.meaning: Foundation/pretrained model (.ckpt, .pt or .pth). Non-null: model and its statistics/model.config are loaded from the file (EMA weights for .ckpt), cast to trainer.precision, and a fresh Lightning fit starts (no optimizer/scheduler/epoch state).

settings.name: finetune
settings.meaning: Fine-tune strategy dict. If null/empty in tace.yaml, ./finetune_config.yaml is read if it exists; if neither exists, full-parameter fine-tuning.

settings.name: finetune.freeze
settings.meaning: Per-parameter freeze flags: True sets requires_grad False. Unknown names only warn.

settings.name: finetune.lora.<module>.r
settings.meaning: LoRA rank written by tace-finetune. In this commit LoRA injection is commented out, so the value is not used.
settings.default_note: LoRA injection code is commented out at tace/lightning/lora.py:15-18; no active code default exists

settings.name: finetune.lora.<module>.alpha
settings.meaning: LoRA alpha written by tace-finetune; not used in this commit (see r).
settings.default_note: LoRA injection code is commented out at tace/lightning/lora.py:15-18; no active code default exists

settings.name: resume_from_model
settings.meaning: Lightning .ckpt to resume full training state (trainer.fit(ckpt_path=...)); separate from finetune.

settings.name: loss.loss_property
settings.meaning: Properties trained; also defines target_property read from the data (e.g. [energy, forces, stress]).
settings.default_note: no default parameter in NormalLoss.__init__ (tace/utils/loss/normal.py:19); value is required by cfg.get(..., None) + assert on line 848

settings.name: loss.loss_function_name
settings.meaning: One registered function per property, prefix mse/mae/huber/l2mae, e.g. mse_energy_per_atom, mse_forces, mse_stress.
settings.default_note: no default parameter in NormalLoss.__init__ (tace/utils/loss/normal.py:20); value is required

settings.name: loss.loss_property_weights[energy]
settings.meaning: Weight of the energy term (list aligned with loss_property; no default).
settings.default_note: no default parameter in NormalLoss.__init__ (tace/utils/loss/normal.py:21); value is required

settings.name: loss.loss_property_weights[forces]
settings.meaning: Weight of the force term.
settings.default_note: no default parameter in NormalLoss.__init__ (tace/utils/loss/normal.py:21); value is required

settings.name: loss.loss_property_weights[stress]
settings.meaning: Weight of the stress term (only when stress is in loss_property).
settings.default_note: no default parameter in NormalLoss.__init__ (tace/utils/loss/normal.py:21); value is required

settings.name: loss.loss_huber_delta
settings.meaning: Huber delta (scalar or per-property list).

settings.name: loss.normalize
settings.meaning: Normalize loss_property_weights to sum 1.

settings.name: loss._target_
settings.meaning: Loss class, normally tace.utils.loss.NormalLoss.
settings.default_note: tace/lightning/lit_model.py:70 loads loss via get_class_from_cfg(cfg['loss']), which requires the cfg key to exist; no default _target_ in TACE

settings.name: optimizer._target_
settings.meaning: Any torch optimizer class path (or tace.utils.optimizer.HybridMuonOptimizer). Required.
settings.default_note: tace/lightning/lit_model.py:483 extracts optimizer_target from cfg and does not provide a default; value is required

settings.name: optimizer.lr
settings.meaning: Learning rate passed to the optimizer class.
settings.default_note: not defaulted in TACE: remaining optimizer keys are splatted into the torch optimizer (tace/lightning/lit_model.py:555-558); default is the torch class's, not in the pinned source; checked tace/lightning/lit_model.py, example/train/tace.yaml

settings.name: optimizer.weight_decay
settings.meaning: Weight decay for the decay group; biases, embeddings, norms, readouts, radial_basis get 0.

settings.name: scheduler
settings.meaning: Any torch LR scheduler class; absent = no scheduler.

settings.name: scheduler.extra.monitor
settings.meaning: Metric for plateau schedulers.

settings.name: scheduler.extra.interval
settings.meaning: epoch or step.

settings.name: scheduler.extra.frequency
settings.meaning: Scheduler step frequency.

settings.name: synth_metric
settings.meaning: Weighted composite validation metric logged as val/synth_metric (weights normalised to sum 1).

settings.name: callbacks.ema
settings.meaning: EMA of model parameters, applied during validation/test and saved in checkpoints; absent = no EMA.

settings.name: callbacks.ema.decay
settings.meaning: EMA decay.

settings.name: callbacks.ema.use_num_updates
settings.meaning: Warm-up EMA decay by update count.

settings.name: callbacks.early_stopping
settings.meaning: Optional Lightning EarlyStopping; absent = no early stopping.

settings.name: callbacks.<ModelCheckpoint>
settings.meaning: At least one ModelCheckpoint callback is mandatory (RuntimeError otherwise).
settings.default_note: tace/lightning/trainer.py:116 raises RuntimeError if no ModelCheckpoint is found in callbacks; value is required

settings.name: trainer.max_epochs
settings.meaning: Lightning max epochs.
settings.default_note: passed verbatim to lightning.Trainer via hydra instantiate (tace/lightning/trainer.py:122-135); the default lives in the lightning package, which is not part of the pinned TACE source tree; checked tace/lightning/trainer.py, tace/scripts/train.py, example/train/tace.yaml

settings.name: trainer.max_time
settings.meaning: Lightning wall-time limit DD:HH:MM:SS.
settings.default_note: passed verbatim to lightning.Trainer via hydra instantiate (tace/lightning/trainer.py:122-135); the default lives in the lightning package, which is not part of the pinned TACE source tree; checked tace/lightning/trainer.py, tace/scripts/train.py, example/train/tace.yaml

settings.name: trainer.precision
settings.meaning: Training precision (64, 32, 16/bf16 variants); required, also used to cast the fine-tuned model.
settings.default_note: tace/utils/utils.py:35 reads cfg['trainer']['precision'] without a default; value is required

settings.name: trainer.accelerator / trainer.devices
settings.meaning: Lightning device selection.
settings.default_note: passed verbatim to lightning.Trainer via hydra instantiate (tace/lightning/trainer.py:122-135); the default lives in the lightning package, which is not part of the pinned TACE source tree; checked tace/lightning/trainer.py, tace/scripts/train.py, example/train/tace.yaml

settings.name: trainer.strategy
settings.meaning: Lightning strategy; tace.utils.strategy.SimpleDDPStrategy for multi-GPU.
settings.default_note: passed verbatim to lightning.Trainer via hydra instantiate (tace/lightning/trainer.py:122-135); the default lives in the lightning package, which is not part of the pinned TACE source tree; checked tace/lightning/trainer.py, tace/scripts/train.py, example/train/tace.yaml

settings.name: trainer.gradient_clip_val
settings.meaning: Lightning gradient clipping.
settings.default_note: passed verbatim to lightning.Trainer via hydra instantiate (tace/lightning/trainer.py:122-135); the default lives in the lightning package, which is not part of the pinned TACE source tree; checked tace/lightning/trainer.py, tace/scripts/train.py, example/train/tace.yaml

settings.name: trainer.num_sanity_val_steps
settings.meaning: Overwritten by TACE: 2 when a validation set exists, 0 with dataset.no_valid_set.

settings.name: misc.global_seed
settings.meaning: Global seed.

settings.name: dataset.split_seed
settings.meaning: Seed of the random train/valid split. NOTE the splitter itself defaults to 1 if the key is absent, while set_global_seed logs 42.

settings.name: misc.allow_tf32
settings.meaning: Enable TF32 matmul/cudnn.

settings.name: misc.device
settings.meaning: cpu or cuda (used by TACE helpers; Lightning uses trainer.accelerator).
settings.default_note: read as cfg['misc']['device'] in the example config (example/train/tace.yaml:19) but no defaulting .get() found in tace/scripts/train.py, tace/lightning/*.py, tace/utils/utils.py

settings.name: misc.LossSkipController.enable
settings.meaning: Skip non-finite or anomalously large batch losses. When enabled, manual_threshold, start_step, ema_window and multiplier must be given explicitly.

settings.name: dataset.type
settings.meaning: ase (any ase.io.read file) or ase-db.

settings.name: dataset.train_file
settings.meaning: Training file. Required.
settings.default_note: tace/dataset/read.py:283 reads cfg['dataset']['train_file'] without a default; value is required

settings.name: dataset.valid_file
settings.meaning: Validation file.

settings.name: dataset.valid_ratio
settings.meaning: Fraction (0,1) split from train_file when valid_file is null and no_valid_set/valid_from_index are false; no default (RuntimeError if missing).
settings.default_note: tace/dataset/read.py:397 reads cfg['dataset']['valid_ratio'] without a default when valid_file is None; raises RuntimeError if missing

settings.name: dataset.valid_from_index
settings.meaning: Reuse train.index/valid.index in cwd.

settings.name: dataset.no_valid_set
settings.meaning: Train without validation (scheduler must not monitor validation).

settings.name: dataset.test_files
settings.meaning: Test file(s); evaluated with ckpt_path='best' after fit.

settings.name: dataset.num_workers
settings.meaning: Processes for parallel file reading.

settings.name: dataset.keys
settings.meaning: Override info/arrays key names; default key name = property name.
settings.default_note: tace/dataset/quantity.py:741 constructs KEYS = {f'{k}_key': k for k in PROPERTY}, generating {energy_key: energy, forces_key: forces, stress_key: stress, ...} for each property; default is <property>_key: <property> pattern

settings.name: dataset.train_dataloader
settings.where: tace.yaml dataset.train_dataloader {_target_: torch_geometric.loader.DataLoader, batch_size, shuffle, num_workers}
settings.meaning: Hydra-instantiated train DataLoader; batch_size has no TACE default.
settings.default_note: tace/dataset/datamodule.py:460 instantiates DataLoader from cfg['dataset']['train_dataloader'] without providing a default; value is required

settings.name: dataset.valid_dataloader
settings.meaning: Hydra-instantiated validation DataLoader.
settings.default_note: tace/dataset/datamodule.py:510 instantiates DataLoader from cfg['dataset']['valid_dataloader'] without providing a default; value is required

settings.name: dataset.storage_mode
settings.meaning: memory or lmdb graph storage.

settings.name: dataset.neighborlist_backend
settings.meaning: ase, vesin or matscipy.

settings.name: dataset.force_dtype
settings.meaning: Force batch float dtype (32/64) at step time.

settings.name: model.config.cutoff
settings.meaning: Graph cutoff used by the datamodule; in finetune model.config is replaced by the checkpoint's config.

settings.name: model.config.fidelity
settings.meaning: Read before the finetune replacement (tace/scripts/train.py:68), so the key must exist in tace.yaml even when fine-tuning.
settings.default_note: tace/scripts/train.py:68 reads cfg['model']['config']['fidelity'] without a default before finetune replacement; value is required
